title: Lablr
tagline: Lablr: Transforming mindless scrolling into meaningful data labeling. Accessible worldwide, empowering all to contribute to future AIs. Simply log in with WorldID, label data, and earn USDC. Lablr provides builders with high quality data.

description:
Lablr is an innovative mobile application that revolutionizes the way people interact with data labeling tasks, making it as engaging and addictive as scrolling through popular social media platforms like TikTok. With Lablr, users can seamlessly browse through a stream of data labeling tasks, complete them with ease, and earn money for their contributions, all while contributing to the development of cutting-edge AI technologies.

For AI creators and developers, Lablr offers a streamlined and efficient solution for acquiring high-quality labeled datasets. By simply posting their data and setting a bounty, they can tap into a global community of enthusiastic data labelers who are eager to contribute to the advancement of AI. The bounty is then fairly distributed among the participants who provide accurate labels, ensuring that the AI creators receive reliable and precise data to train their models.

Key Features and Benefits:

- Engaging User Experience: Lablr's interface mimics the familiar and addictive scrolling experience of popular social media apps, making data labeling tasks feel like a fun and engaging activity rather than a tedious chore.
- Monetization Opportunity: Users can earn money by completing data labeling tasks, providing a unique opportunity to generate income while contributing to the development of AI technologies.
- Quality Assurance: Lablr employs a robust verification system to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the labeled data. The bounty is only distributed among users who provide correct answers, incentivizing participants to maintain high standards of quality.
- Global Accessibility: With Lablr, anyone with a smartphone can participate in data labeling tasks, regardless of their location or background. This fosters a diverse and inclusive community of contributors from around the world.
- Seamless Data Collection: AI creators can easily post their data and set a bounty on Lablr, eliminating the need for complex data collection processes. The app handles the distribution of tasks and the aggregation of labeled data, saving time and resources.
- Scalability: Lablr's large and growing user base ensures that AI creators can quickly obtain substantial amounts of labeled data, enabling faster iterations and accelerated development of their AI models.

By gamifying the data labeling process and combining it with the engaging experience of social media scrolling, Lablr transforms a once tedious task into an enjoyable and rewarding activity. It empowers individuals to contribute to the advancement of AI while earning money, and provides AI creators with a reliable and efficient means of acquiring high-quality labeled datasets. With Lablr, the future of AI development becomes more accessible, collaborative, and inclusive than ever before.
how_its_made:
Frontend in nextjs with chakraUI. 
Backend in FastAPI + mysql. We only store the labels in the database.
The files that need to be labeled (provided by the client) are stored on lighthouse and are encrypted.
Solidity contract deployed on base sepolia (https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0x6Efe62FE16CcAAb7e68923C42002308fc0011BC5).

For users to log in we use World ID to verify that the user is a real person. All interactions with the blockchain (payments & claims of bounties) happen through Web3Auth which uses Auth0 from World ID as identity source.
